title: Growing a Sympoietic Art Organism
subtitle: An Experiment Tracking the Micro-Dynamics of Cultural Evolution
description: Observational gaps, survival bias, and noise in retrospective reporting often significantly limit empirical tracking of cultural evolution. Empirical data recording how cultural artifacts, motifs, and lineages form in real time are therefore of great benefit and interest in this area of research. To study these dynamics, we present a closed, participatory modeling experiment implemented through a structured collaborative artmaking exercise. Our experimental design attempts to richly capture the bottom-up emergence of a shared cultural heritage in a small, controlled setting, as well as the influences at play throughout its evolution.

title: RemoteSensing Paclet: GIBS Satellite Imagery and AppEEARS Geographic Data Products
description: Each year, the Wolfram Summer School brings together undergraduate and graduate students, postdoctoral scholars, professors and professionals to develop computational research projects using Wolfram Language. This curated collection of student projects from the 2023 Summer School covers various disciplines, including data science, physics, artificial intelligence, social sciences, computational biology, finance and more.Participants present their methodologies and findings through detailed reports, illustrating how computational tools can advance research across disciplines. These proceedings provide concrete examples of Wolfram technology applications for researchers, educators and practitioners in a wide range of fields.
